headline: Warsh Signals Steady Fed Amid Inflation, Semis Drop, Oil Hits $110
summary: The U.S. faces a near $2 trillion budget deficit and 5% Treasury yields, as Fed's Warsh signals a steady outlook despite inflation concerns. Semiconductor stocks saw over 5% declines, while oil prices surged to $110 on Middle East tensions. Tesla unveiled a 'flying' Roadster, and SpaceX expanded its infrastructure plays.

bullets.lead: Fed's Warsh signals a steady outlook despite inflation concerns.

segments.text: Kevin Warsh, a new Fed Chair candidate, emphasized taming inflation while acknowledging AI's economic impact, suggesting a steady policy stance despite recent inflation jumps.

sources.title: Warsh Vows to Tame Inflation as A.I. Delivers ‘Shock’ to Economy
Warsh signals steady Fed outlook despite inflation jump

segments.text: Emerging-market stocks gained as Warsh backed AI optimism, while analysts anticipate the Fed to hold rates in October, though a surprise remains possible.

sources.title: Emerging-Market Stocks Gain as Fed’s Warsh Backs AI Optimism
